verdict.rationale: LightSprint says tasks can be created directly from Linear or Jira with two-way sync, and that its cloud agents work those tasks while it manages ticket state. That covers the core of the story. However, the only evidence is brief marketing lines, and none of them shows the explicit step of assigning an agent from within an existing ticket. Missing for 10: documented flow for assigning an agent from an existing issue, coverage of GitHub Issues or other trackers, detail on how ticket content becomes the agent's task spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can assign a coding task to an agent directly from an existing issue or ticket
